advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 18/20 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.188 over 20 corners (11 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 8.69; 2/2 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.84) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 6 stops (0 both-axle, 1 front-first, 0 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
